name: @resus/module_08_route_optimization
description: Module 8 — route optimization. Plans the response leg (ambulance to scene) and transport leg (scene to hospital) using a pluggable routing provider, records each route and its provenance through module 11, and emits ROUTE_GENERATED / ROUTE_FAILED. The default provider is deterministic and labelled as a non-live estimate; a real OSRM provider is available but off by default.
